requirements.description: Solid insulation forming a MEANS OF OPERATOR PROTECTION shall comply with dielectric strength test of 8.8 at test voltage of Table 6, or requirements of IEC 60950-1 / IEC 62368-1 for INSULATION CO-ORDINATION.
CREEPAGE and CLEARANCES forming a MEANS OF OPERATOR PROTECTION shall comply with limits of Tables 13 to 16 (inclusive) or requirements of IEC 60950-1 / IEC 62368-1 for INSULATION CO-ORDINATION.
PROTECTIVE EARTH CONNECTIONS forming a MEANS OF OPERATOR PROTECTION shall comply with Cl. 8.6 or requirements of IEC 60950-1 / IEC 62368-1 for protective earthing.
Y2 capacitor (IEC 60384-14) is considered one MEANS OF OPERATOR PROTECTION.
Y1 capacitor (IEC 60384-14) is considered two MEANS OF OPERATOR PROTECTION.
Two capacitors used in series, each RATED for total WORKING VOLTAGE across the pair with same NOMINAL capacitance, considered as insulation means.
Optocouplers complying with IEC 60747-5-5:2007 or later edition considered equivalent to requirements in 8.8.2 and 8.9.3.

PATIENT CONNECTIONS of F-TYPE APPLIED PART shall be separated from all other parts by equivalent to one MEANS OF PATIENT PROTECTION for a WORKING VOLTAGE equal to maximum MAINS VOLTAGE, complying with limit for PATIENT LEAKAGE CURRENT at 110% of max.
Separation requirement not applied between multiple functions of a single F-TYPE APPLIED PART.
Classification as TYPE BF, CF, or DEFIBRILLATION-PROOF applies to one entire APPLIED PART.
A protective device connected between PATIENT CONNECTIONS of an F-TYPE APPLIED PART and ENCLOSURE to protect against excessive voltages shall not operate below 500 V r.m.s.

PATIENT CONNECTIONS of a TYPE B APPLIED PART not PROTECTIVELY EARTHED shall be separated by one MEANS OF PATIENT PROTECTION from metal ACCESSIBLE PARTS not PROTECTIVELY EARTHED, except when metal ACCESSIBLE PART is physically close to APPLIED PART and can be regarded as part of APPLIED PART.

semantic_fragments.content: Points at which impedances of components, CREEPAGE, CLEARANCES, PROTECTIVE EARTH CONNECTIONS or insulation, prevent ACCESSIBLE PARTS from exceeding limits in 8.4 examined whether a failure at any of these points is to be regarded as a NORMAL or SINGLE FAULT CONDITION. A MEANS OF PROTECTION protecting APPLIED PARTS, or parts identified by 4.6 as parts subject to the same requirements, considered MEANS OF PATIENT PROTECTION. A MEANS OF PROTECTION protecting other parts considered MEANS OF OPERATOR PROTECTION.

PATIENT CONNECTIONS treated as one APPLIED PART in the absence of electrical separation between PATIENT CONNECTIONS of same or another function. MANUFACTURER has defined if multiple functions are to be considered as all within one APPLIED PART or as multiple APPLIED PARTS.
